description: Mechanical cross-check of central_bridge_triangle_s5.md Part VI.1's lobe-forcing argument: on an explicit double-S5 gadget (triangle a-b-c, two central bridges B_a,B_b both reaching a single shared cut vertex z of degree exactly 4), the triangle T is forced entirely into one lobe of G-z, and the attachment-free leaf sits entirely in the other -- confirming the abstractly-possible 'opposite lobes' distribution never occurs, independent of the hand argument.
scope_note: Does not re-derive S5 itself (cited by name: at most one cut vertex, degree exactly 4). What is checked: on the constructed gadget, z is a genuine articulation point of degree 4, removing z leaves T connected in one component, the leaf in a disjoint second component, and exactly two lobes total -- via networkx.articulation_points/node_connected_component/number_connected_components, independent of the markdown's structural argument.
note_on_python_version: Same environment note as prior manifests: requirements.txt/.python-version pin CPython 3.14.6, unavailable in this container; this run used 3.13.12 with networkx==3.6.1 (matches requirements.txt's pin exactly).
detector_agreement: Uses networkx directly (articulation_points, node_connected_component, number_connected_components), independent of this project's hand-rolled cycle/component checkers used elsewhere. 0 disagreements with the hand-derived prediction.
completed_range: One small, deterministic illustrative gadget realizing the L=L' instance of the forced configuration, not a search or census -- consistent with the phase's explicit decision not to launch broad computation.
